independent_review_findings.subject: D12_CONTROL_MEASUREMENTS
independent_review_findings.finding: The persistent D12 audit binds all six PASS outcomes, implementation blob, seed-spec SHA-256, workflow/job identity, zero physical counters and physical evidence NONE.

binding_semantics_observations.observation: freeze_stage_metric is called once from the initial stage state before the ETRN-02 iteration loop; field and parameter scales are therefore stage-initialization constants.
The current generic ETRN-02 implementation has no inner backtracking-factor loop. A rejected clipped trial shrinks Delta and consumes an outer iteration before recomputing the direction.

The current generic etrn02_solve_generic calls jacobian_fn(state) once for the equilibrated direction and a second time for model_reduction_ratio within an iteration. A later single-Jacobian cache/refactor would alter implementation semantics/source identity and requires a separately versioned implementation plus manufactured controls before physical binding.
The D12 stiff known-root control is a deterministic manufactured linear system. Passing it does not validate nonlinear MD2S basin geometry or physical convergence.
The seed-spec file freezes the BJP-01 construction recipe, not evaluated physical CP01R3 seed vectors. D14 must create a distinct source-bound generated-seed manifest/hash before any release review.

review_conclusion: BJP-01 and ETRN-02 are internally consistent with the D11 design and the D12 manufactured audit within the registered control scope. D13 finds no blocker to a separate D14 exact binding/freeze block. D13 does not authorize physical backend evaluation or CP01R3 execution. D14 must preserve the reviewed implementation semantics exactly or version any change and repeat manufactured controls.
